title: Lady Vox (seasonal)
summary: Seasonal Lady Vox calls ice creatures and adds spell attacks at key health thresholds.
overview: Seasonal Lady Vox calls ice creatures and adds spell attacks at key health thresholds.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Two ice adds appear at 70% health and three more at 40%. Reserve tanks and control for both waves.
Vox casts additional scripted spells at 60%, 30% and 10%. Prepare tank support before crossing those thresholds.
Keep Vox near her lair’s spawn area. Her combat routine checks the leash continuously.
The seasonal version uses a different appearance and permits the expedition’s higher-level participants; the ordinary version’s level-based banishment is not used here.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.

This guide targets the explicit version 200 seasonal branch. The 50%, 20% and 5% messages are flavor-only in the reviewed configuration, so no additional damage mechanic is claimed at those thresholds.
Resolve the encounter NPC template ID before publication; the reviewed files do not identify it unambiguously.
